# stalwart_arf_external_report (Data Source)

Stores an ARF feedback report received from an external source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When the report is scheduled to be deleted
- `from` (String) Email address of the report sender
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this report belongs to Requires an Enterprise license.
- `received_at` (String) When the report email was received
- `report` (Attributes) Parsed ARF feedback report content (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report))
- `subject` (String) Subject line of the report email
- `to` (Set of String) List of recipient email addresses

<a id="nestedatt--report"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report`

Read-Only:

- `arrival_date` (String) When the original message arrived
- `auth_failure` (String) Type of authentication failure (for auth-failure reports)
- `authentication_results` (Set of String) Authentication-Results header values from the original message
- `delivery_result` (String) What happened to the original message
- `dkim_adsp_dns` (String) DKIM ADSP DNS record content
- `dkim_canonicalized_body` (String) Message body after DKIM canonicalization
- `dkim_canonicalized_header` (String) Message headers after DKIM canonicalization
- `dkim_domain` (String) Domain from the DKIM signature
- `dkim_identity` (String) Identity from the DKIM signature (i= tag)
- `dkim_selector` (String) Selector from the DKIM signature
- `dkim_selector_dns` (String) DKIM selector DNS record content
- `feedback_type` (String) Type of feedback being reported
- `headers` (String) Original message headers that triggered the report
- `identity_alignment` (String) Which identities were aligned
- `incidents` (Number) Number of incidents represented by this report
- `message` (String) Original message content that triggered the report
- `original_envelope_id` (String) Original SMTP envelope ID (ENVID)
- `original_mail_from` (String) Original envelope sender address (MAIL FROM)
- `original_rcpt_to` (String) Original envelope recipient address (RCPT TO)
- `reported_domains` (Set of String) Domains being reported
- `reported_uris` (Set of String) URIs being reported
- `reporting_mta` (String) Hostname of the MTA generating this report
- `source_ip` (String) IP address of the original message source
- `source_port` (Number) Port of the original message source
- `spf_dns` (String) SPF DNS record content
- `user_agent` (String) Software that generated this report
- `version` (Number) ARF format version
